appraisal_events.evidence: «cela dépend de ce monsieur-là, demandez-lui. Enfin, entrez un moment si vous voulez, mais pas longtemps, parce que je vous préviens qu'il aime causer tranquillement avec moi, et qu'il n'aime pas beaucoup qu'il y ait des visites quand il vient.»
appraisal_events.explanation: Odette makes Forcheville's entry conditional on Swann's permission and caps his visit to a short, tolerated interruption, publicly subordinating him to Swann within her home.

status_effects.explanation: Forcheville is reduced to a supplicant who must ask permission and is granted only a brief, conditional presence, marking his eclipse relative to Swann in this scene.

ambiguities: Forcheville's subordination here is the mirror image of Swann's already-captured elevation (E1) in the accepted annotation, arising from the same interaction; it is recorded separately only because it gives Forcheville a distinct local outcome (conditional, curtailed access) rather than reversing the accepted event's direction.
